_doc: Species (docs/CONTENT.md section 9), read by scripts/crew/crew_member.gd. A crew member's `species` (set by the ship design's `crew` list) sets their max hp (hp), walk speed (speed, a factor on the 3 cells/s base), traits (ids of the trait library, data/traits.json; merged with personal traits from data/crew.json and gear traits, see CrewMember.traits() and TraitSet.of), the art folder they are drawn with (rig: art/crew/<rig>/) and the hand weapon they carry (sidearm: an id of data/hand_weapons.json, drawn when idle in a fight). A species may also carry trait keys inline (work_mult on basalt), merged before its traits. What the keys do: data/traits.json `_doc`. `drone: true` marks a repair drone (see the drone entry). default: the species of anyone whose design names none. The `traits` table that used to live here is still read for trait ids data/traits.json does not define.

basalt.name: Basalt
basalt.notes: bad medics: heal_others 0.5; no helmet in the art

emberkin.name: Emberkin
emberkin.notes: can stand in overheated rooms: only species with `dries_out` are hurt by room heat, so nothing to exempt

drone.name: Repair Drone
drone.notes: playtest 2 (R1): a small hovering robot the player never steers. `drone: true` makes it a drone (CrewMember.is_drone): not crew (no bed, no morale, no crew count), it takes only the jobs of data/crew.json `drone_jobs`, draws crew.json drone.power from the ship's surplus (no cable) and shuts down without it, and at 0 hp it is broken, not dead (a crewmate mends it). It breathes nothing, shrugs off fire (x0.25) and is no patient for a bed or a medbay; it works at 0.6 speed. Drawn in code (PersonDrawer.draw_drone): there is no art/crew/drone.
